captures.description: THE CONSORTIUM, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'The Crowd Counting Consortium (CCC) is a joint research project that tracks and collects public data on political protests, marches, rallies, strikes, and acts of civil disobedience across the United States.' Founders, home, scope, scale, data access. Six cards: Harvard, Counting Crowds (two), boB Rudis, Policy Commons, X.

atoms.evidence: The Crowd Counting Consortium (CCC) is a joint research project
Co-founded in 2017 by Erica Chenoweth (Harvard University) and Jeremy Pressman (University of Connecticut)
tracks and collects public data on political protests, marches, rallies, strikes, and acts of civil disobedience across the United States.
